title: Jahmyr Gibbs named NFC offensive player of the week for the fourth time

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jahmyr Gibbs named NFC offensive player of the week for the fourth time
sources.description: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs has picked up touchdowns at a furious rate over the course of his NFL career and he kept adding to that total in last Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
